outsideSpendingCexShareRetail.citation: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2023: food at home, apparel, household furnishings, vehicles purchases and other goods bought at stores, about a third of average annual expenditures.

outsideSpendingCexShareFood.citation: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2023: food away from home, about 5.6 percent of average annual expenditures.

outsideSpendingCexShareHealth.citation: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2023: health care, about 8 percent of average annual expenditures.

outsideSpendingCexShareServices.citation: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey 2023: personal care, entertainment services and other services, about 5 percent of average annual expenditures.

outsideSpendingDayOfMonth.citation: Mid-month, between most paydays and the rent day.
